lines.zh: 我提着锤子走，步子很沉。
lines.en: I walk with a hammer, and my steps are heavy.

lines.zh: 铁靴踩在石头上，咔咔响。
lines.en: Iron boots click and clack on the stone.

lines.zh: 我往矿洞去，主人在下面。
lines.en: I head for the mine; my master is below.

lines.zh: 走慢些，我的砧还挂在腰上。
lines.en: Slow down; my anvil still hangs at my belt.

lines.zh: 锤柄磨得发亮，路也走熟了。
lines.en: My hammer haft is worn smooth, and I know the road.
I do not detour; a straight line is shortest.

lines.zh: 火星从我脚印里跳出来。
lines.en: Sparks jump out of my footprints.

lines.zh: 这条矿道是我一锤一锤开的。
lines.en: I opened this tunnel one hammer blow at a time.

lines.zh: 别走在我前面，会吃到火星。
lines.en: Do not walk ahead of me; you will catch sparks.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边听石头的声音。
lines.en: I walk and listen to what the stone says.

lines.zh: 炉子还热，我得快些回去。
lines.en: The forge is still hot; I must hurry back.
After this stretch, I will mend your armor.

lines.zh: 我坐着磨锤头，磨到发亮。
lines.en: I sit and grind my hammer head until it shines.
A smaller flame makes the iron obey.

lines.zh: 我在数今天崩了几个刃口。
lines.en: I am counting the edges that chipped today.

lines.zh: 砧上还有一块没打完的铁。
lines.en: A piece of iron still sits unfinished on the anvil.
My hands are all soot, and it will not wipe off.

lines.zh: 我听着滴水声，判断火候。
lines.en: I judge the heat by the sound of dripping water.

lines.zh: 打铁的时候，我不用说话。
lines.en: At the anvil I have no need to speak.

lines.zh: 这块铁锭我留着升级用。
lines.en: I am saving this ingot for an upgrade.
I squint at the fire, and the fire squints back.
Three fingers of my glove are burnt through.

lines.zh: 闲下来，我就给锤子上油。
lines.en: When idle, I oil the hammer.

lines.zh: 使魔不用吃饭，只要好铁。
lines.en: A familiar needs no meals, only good iron.
Stone dust settles on my shoulders like snow.
These tongs have stayed with me a long while.

lines.zh: 铁水凝了，我敲掉边上的渣。
lines.en: The iron set. I knock off the slag.

lines.zh: 锤柄上的布，我又缠了两圈。
lines.en: Two more wraps of cloth on the hammer.
That armor of yours needs its edges mended.
Let me see your bracer; it is cracked.
Hold still; I am measuring your shoulders.
The calluses on your hands come from work.

lines.zh: 我在看你的剑，重心偏了。
lines.en: I am studying your sword; its balance is off.
Half your boot soles are worn flat.
My master calls you; I have noted it.
You smell of rust, and I know that smell.
Lift your chin; I am checking the collar clasp.
You would suit a hammer; your wrist is steady.
Do not mind my look; I charge nothing.
Your shield wants a new facing.

lines.zh: 我从下往上打量，找裂口。
lines.en: I look you over from below, hunting cracks.
I have iron dust in my eye; one moment.
Iron hurts too; it just stays quiet.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在没有护甲的地方。
lines.en: That landed where I wear no plate.
I nearly lost my hammer.
My shoulder caved; let me brace it.

lines.zh: 别打断我，我正锤到关键。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; I am at the critical blow.
This wound wants a cold quench.
Pain fills my ears with ringing.
Sparks landed on an old wound.
I can still stand, and the hammer holds.
That blow was harsher than slag.
Hand me the ingot, not the bread.

lines.zh: 好铁的味道，隔墙都闻得到。
lines.en: Good iron smells through walls.
This piece is enough to upgrade a familiar.

lines.zh: 你举着铁的样子很诚恳。
lines.en: You hold that iron very earnestly.
I am not greedy for food, but for good stock.
Raw iron will do; I am not fussy.
Set it down and go; do not tease me.
This one is slaggy and needs another melt.
Iron in the forge makes my hands itch.

lines.zh: 给我铁，我给你一双手艺。
lines.en: Give me iron, and I give you craft.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，火星溅你一身。
lines.en: One bump and sparks shower over you.

lines.zh: 我身上硬，你脚趾别怪我。
lines.en: I am hard all over; do not blame me for your toes.
Steady; I nearly dropped the hammer.
Make way; I am carrying the anvil.
Do not shove a smith; smiths hold grudges.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我肩上的灰全落了。
lines.en: That knock shook all the dust off my shoulders.
You hit iron, not flesh.
Back half a step so I can swing.

lines.zh: 碰撞声在矿洞里回了两遍。
lines.en: The clang echoed twice through the tunnel.
Careful; the tong tips are sharp.
Familiars do not discuss that; we discuss heat.
This forge is the only partner I keep.

lines.zh: 打铁打了一辈子，没空成家。
lines.en: A lifetime at the anvil left no time for a family.

lines.zh: 你问错人了，去问山羊使魔。
lines.en: You ask the wrong one; try the goat familiar.

lines.zh: 被召唤来的，生不出小的。
lines.en: Summoned things do not bear young.
Hammer and anvil make the only pair.

lines.zh: 我给别的使魔升级，不做媒。
lines.en: I upgrade other familiars, I do not matchmake.
Iron cools; I do not.
This topic is more useless than slag.
Ask again when the forge goes out.
I will take this iron; it will be used.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起，膝盖响了一声。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up and my knee creaks.
Dropped ore should not be wasted.
I use tongs, not fingers.
There are still iron flecks in this rubble.
I pick it up to melt and reforge later.
It is heavy, and I can carry it.
Put it by the anvil, not in a heap.
What I gather is stock, not rubbish.
This piece can patch your chestplate.

lines.zh: 那东西在挖我们的矿脉。
lines.en: That thing is digging into our vein.
It blocks the tunnel; clear it.

lines.zh: 我看见它的甲缝，在肋下。
lines.en: I see the gap in its plating, under the ribs.
My master is still below; I strike first.

lines.zh: 这只够硬，配得上我的锤。
lines.en: This one is hard enough for my hammer.
It knocked down a stretch of supports.

lines.zh: 目标定了，别挡我的挥锤道。
lines.en: Target set; clear my swing.
The stone is shaking; it is close.
Hit the legs first and bring it down.
It carries iron, which is mine after.
Its blood smells sour to me.
I will handle this one; stand back.
Lend me a little strength, forge.
It moved, and so did the hammer.
I am hunting its seam; do not rush me.
Aim at the joint and one blow unhinges it.
The hammer is up; move away.
I drop the hammer on three.
It guards its neck, so I take the waist.

lines.zh: 这一锤要打在旧裂口上。
lines.en: This blow lands on the old crack.

lines.zh: 脚站稳了，力才传得过去。
lines.en: My feet are planted, so the force carries.
Do not speak to me at this moment.

lines.zh: 它的影子在墙上，我照着打。
lines.en: Its shadow is on the wall, and I aim there.
The angle is wrong; I shift half a step.
My hammer face is chipped, so I aim off-center.
Breathe in, raise, strike.

lines.zh: 我看见它下一次要往哪扑。
lines.en: I see where it will lunge next.
The target is not running; it is waiting.

lines.zh: 它的护甲有缝，就从那里进。
lines.en: There is a seam in its armor. I go there.
One hammer blow and sparks fly everywhere.
I break armor, not flesh.
That sound is like a misstruck forge blow.

lines.zh: 回手再补一记，别留活口。
lines.en: A backhand follows; leave nothing alive.

lines.zh: 一锤回震，虎口裂了道口。
lines.en: The rebound splits the web of my hand.
Did you hear the bone give way?

lines.zh: 我打铁三十年，打这个也一样。
lines.en: Thirty years at iron; this is no different.
It collapsed like a wall.
Do not stand close; shards will fly.

lines.zh: 这一下，算给矿道的赔礼。
lines.en: This blow repays the ruined tunnel.

lines.zh: 炉火一亮，我就站在砧边。
lines.en: The forge flares, and I stand by the anvil.

lines.zh: 粉笔灰还没落，锤子先响了。
lines.en: Before the chalk settles, the hammer rings.
I have been called to work again.

lines.zh: 手上还带着上次的炭黑。
lines.en: My hands still carry soot from last time.
Master, is the forge lit?

lines.zh: 我认得这间屋子的每块砖。
lines.en: I know every brick of this room.
First the forge, then the work.

lines.zh: 契约把我从火里拽了出来。
lines.en: The pact pulled me out of the fire.
Hammer here, tongs here; I lack only iron.
This summoning circle was drawn crooked.

lines.zh: 我从烟里走出来，别呛着。
lines.en: I step out of the smoke; do not choke.
If there is work, say so plainly.
This hand is newly formed and still warm.

lines.zh: 我来了，石头可以开始裂。
lines.en: I am here; the stone may start to crack.
Fire is hot, but I do not fear it.
I fell, and my iron boots landed first.
Filled with water, I feel dull all over.
The blast sent my hammer head flying.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我背上，像根钉子。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like a nail.
Magic seeped into the seams of my pact.
Without iron, I have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在铁上，我麻了半身。
lines.en: Lightning struck the iron and numbed half of me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有砧，我手空着。
lines.en: The void has no anvil, and my hands are empty.
